question: Which auspicious conjunctions are especially favorable for longevity and love?
premises: The prīti conjunction is long-lived and favorable.
The brahma conjunction is also favorable.
The brahma conjunction is especially so.
inference: Both prīti and brahma conjunctions support longevity and love, with brahma being especially auspicious.
plain_english: It is long-lived in the prīti conjunction and also, especially, in the brahma conjunction.
